court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mr. T. Ragangam, GA
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

M. Dhandapani, J.:— This petition has been filed seeking a direction to the Respondents to consider the petitioner's representation dated 16-2-2026 to conduct enquiry and issue legal heirship certificate in favour of the petitioners father Late K. Sugumar.

2. It is the case of the petitioner that her father K. Sugumar, Son of Late K. Kumaravel died on 13-6-2021 at Rajiv Gandhi General Hospital, Chennai-3 and the death certificate has also been issued by the Greater Chennai Corporation. The paternal grandparents of the petitioner were pre-deceased. It is alleged that the deceased Sugumar has two wives. The petitioner's mother is the first wife viz Santhanam and the second wife viz. Padmavathy, who is not having any children, has given no objection certificate stating that she has no objection to issue legal heirship certificate to the petitioner and her mother. In such circumstances, the petitioner made an application before the respondents on 3-6-2025 for issuance of legal heir certificate. However, the respondents have not taken any action in this regard. Therefore, the petitioner has again made a representation on 16-2-2026 to issue a legal heir certificate of his father K. Sugumar and the same is pending. Hence, the petitioner has filed the present writ petition.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that though the application for issuance of legal heir ship certificate is pending since 2025, there is no action on the part of the respondents. Hence, this Court may issue a direction to the respondents to consider and pass orders on the petitioner's representation within the stipulated time as fixed by this Court.

4. The learned government advocate appearing for the respondent submitted that the petitioner's representation will be considered and orders will be passed within the stipulated time as fixed by this Court.

5. Heard the learned counsel for both side and perused the materials available on record.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and in view of the limited relief sought for by the petitioner, this Court directs the second respondent to conduct enquiry on the petitioner's representation dated 16-2-2026 and to issue legal heir certificate of the deceased K. Sugumar to the eligible persons based on the documents filed and file a report before this Court on or before 1-4-2026.

7. With the above directions, the writ petition is disposed of. No costs.

8. Post the case “for reporting compliance” on 1-4-2026.
